quests.title: The Window Above Carramar
quests.blurb: I live above the platform at Carramar and I know this line by sound. Something in the rhythm changed about a month ago and everyone I tell thinks I am mad. Ride it and tell me whether I am mad.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Homebush
quests.blurb: Five in the morning at Homebush, in the dark, unloading a van by feel. The bloke in the next bay has started arriving at four to take half my frontage. I need a witness and I need them at four.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$80 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Pendle Hill
quests.blurb: The clock on the Pendle Hill platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Find out who set it that way, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Toongabbie, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Narara
quests.blurb: A dog meets the 5:40 at Narara every weekday and nobody gets off for it. Four months of this. I have decided it is not going to be a sad story. Find out whose it is.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Lakemba
quests.blurb: Up four hundred over eleven weeks on the Lakemba delay market. You cannot beat a delay book unless you can see the roster, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. Think about who can see the roster.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$82 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Lindfield
quests.blurb: The last one through Lindfield carries four people and one of them is always asleep. Ride it to Roseville, photograph the platform with nobody on it, and come back and tell me the place still exists when there is no one in it.

steps.label: ride the late one to Roseville
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Wollstonecraft Tap-Off
quests.blurb: Somebody taps on at Wollstonecraft at half six and never taps off. Same card, 20 months running. Ride the run they ride and find where a person gets off this network without a gate seeing them.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Macquarie Park Order
quests.blurb: Two hundred coffees out of Macquarie Park before quarter to six and I know every one of them by the walk. The cleaner who does the whole line stopped coming three weeks back. Take one over to where they work and find out whether I lost them to the chain up the road.

steps.label: order one at the Macquarie Park kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $78 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Cheltenham
quests.blurb: The board at Cheltenham says four minutes. It has said four minutes since before the merge and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand under it, time it, and bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Hawkesbury River
quests.blurb: Everything anyone leaves on the Hawkesbury River line ends up in a room and the room is full. Nine hundred umbrellas and one a laminated sign with a name on it and a number that rings out. Go to the address on the tag.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$65 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Campbelltown
quests.blurb: Speakerphone. Grand final week, Campbelltown to town, speakerphone. I have made eye contact eleven times and it has achieved nothing.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Auburn Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier has a route that is not on a map and mine goes through Auburn. They have started locking one end. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$82, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Punchbowl
quests.blurb: Third time at Punchbowl on grand final week. Not kids — kids run. This one walks, and they keep sending a different bloke. I need it stopped before somebody writes a very long report about me.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Revesby Regular
quests.blurb: Same stool since before I bought the place off Revesby road. Gone since school holidays, and I am past being reasonable about it. I would like to know whether to keep the stool.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Liverpool
quests.blurb: People have started parking on the grass at Liverpool because of one abandoned car, and it has been like that since the merge. Photograph it, and the date on the ticket, so somebody can be embarrassed by it.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$51 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Sydenham
quests.blurb: Council pays me to paint over things and last week I painted over something good. There is another one near Sydenham that I am scheduled to kill on Thursdays. Photograph it first.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: The Hill Above Killara
quests.blurb: I drive past the same view above Killara eleven times a shift and I have never once stopped at it. You have got legs and no timetable. Go up and photograph what I have been driving past for 5 years.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$59, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at Hurstville
quests.blurb: Done at Hurstville on school holidays for something that is only an offence if a sign says so, and I am past being reasonable about it. How do you photograph a thing not being somewhere? That is your problem now.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Wansey Road
quests.blurb: A metre of dirt between the fence and the footpath at Wansey Road, dead for 14 years and not dead now. Council mows on the fifteenth and does not know what is in it. Stand near it and stop the man with the whipper snipper.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Norwest
quests.blurb: Ten to six, nobody in the building but us and a radio that gets one station. Somebody has been taking things and they know our roster, which means they come in off the late train at Norwest.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$64 of what they took, back
